blocks.text: Composites aaj kal ke bohat kaam ke aur faidemand materials hain. Composite do ya zyada materials ka milap hai jis se behtar properties wali cheez banti hai. Aik hissa matrix kehlata hai, aur doosre hisse jo matrix ke andar band (caged) hote hain, reinforcement agents (mazbooti dene wale) kehlate hain. Kuch composites mein aik se zyada reinforcement agent hote hain. Misal fibreglass hai: is mein polymer matrix hai, aur reinforcement kapre (fabric), glass ya carbon wale materials ke fibres (reshe) ho sakte hain. Matrix reinforcement ko pakre rakhta hai, aur reinforcement material ko zyada strength deta hai. Composites ka strength to weight ratio (wazan ke muqable mazbooti) achha hai aur yeh corrosion se bohat bachte hain, is liye mushkil kaamon ke liye munasib hain. Maslan kashtiyon ke hull (neeche ka dhancha) aur gariyon ki bodies fibreglass se banti hain, aur carbon fibre halka aur bohat der tak chalne wala hone ki wajah se aircraft aur sports ke saaman ki industry mein bohat use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Composite mein matrix aur reinforcement ka kya kaam hai?
blocks.explanation: Matrix reinforcement ko apni jagah pakre rakhta hai; reinforcement (jaise glass ya carbon ke fibres) material ko zyada strength deta hai.

items: Fibreglass: kashtiyon ke hull, gariyon ki bodies, insulation; carbon fibre: aircraft, sports gear.
